en-US.title: Park Jun-geum's Chuncheon Local Experience (ft. Oil Squeezing)
en-US.description:
Hello Pinks!

Today, Angelina came to the Chuncheon Market to squeeze sesame oil and perilla oil.

I told you that sesame oil is the most important ingredient in my favorite carrot kimbap.
I love nutty flavors, so I choose my oil very carefully.

Since I'm visiting my hometown of Chuncheon, I'm going to go to the market and squeeze some oil!

I've tasted oil squeezed at oil shops before, but this is my first time seeing and tasting freshly squeezed oil in person. It's so, so nutty!!

I want to share this nutty flavor with you Pinks!

Shall we roast some sesame seeds together?? lol

en-US.title: 🚗Park Jun-geum's regular restaurant on the Chuncheon gourmet road (a place I keep going back to):...
en-US.description:
Hello Pinks!

Today, Angelina will introduce you to a great restaurant in Chuncheon!

When you think of Chuncheon, the first thing that comes to mind is dakgalbi (spicy stir-fried chicken)!

But I'm not a big fan of chicken, so I'll skip dakgalbi.

The second famous dish in Chuncheon is makguksu (buckwheat noodles).
The makguksu restaurant I always go to is my father's favorite.
It's a long-standing place I've been going to since I was little.
The makguksu is made with 100% pure buckwheat, with a smooth texture and a mild seasoning.
I recommend it to anyone who wants to try authentic makguksu.

And you all know I love barley gulbi (grilled short ribs), right?
I always eat barley gulbi when I go here. The delicious wild vegetable side dishes and soy sauce marinated crab also come to mind.

When I go to Chuncheon, it's a must-visit.
It's so memorable that I'd be sad not to go. When you're in Chuncheon, you should definitely try it!

✅Saembat Makguksu Main Branch
1st Floor, 644 Sinsaembat-ro, Sinbuk-eup, Chuncheon-si, Gangwon-do

✅Gosan-ga
7 Neoburae-gil, Dongnae-myeon, Chuncheon-si, Gangwon-do

Angelina doesn't necessarily lose weight because she's a celebrity. She's striving to make Park Jun-geum's life beautiful. It's not easy for me either, since I do it every day. I've made a lot of mistakes trying to make it a part of my daily routine...
